title: Inventory Count Log Form
subtitle: Warehouse Inventory Count: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Inventory Count Log Form covers item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance. The inventory control coordinator records Warehouse Inventory Count events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Inventory Count Log Form keeps Warehouse Inventory Count exceptions visible until the inventory control coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Inventory Count Log Form at warehouse zone, bin, staging location, quarantine area, and system record. Document item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance identity before Warehouse Inventory Count begins. Compare item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance findings with stated Warehouse Inventory Count criteria; route unresolved Warehouse Inventory Count issues to authorized inventory reviewer. For Inventory Count Log Form, confirm requirements for Warehouse Inventory Count. Ask authorized inventory reviewer to review Warehouse Inventory Count conditions beyond the inventory control coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking review and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Warehouse Inventory Count, identify responsible parties, warehouse zone, bin, staging location, quarantine area, and system record, and the linked item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance source.

sections.title: Status events and next-control history
sections.guidance: Capture Warehouse Inventory Count facts for item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance; include result, limit, source, and next control.

items: Recent receipt, pick, transfer, or adjustment

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: Reconcile the latest Warehouse Inventory Count event before closeout. Inventory Control Coordinator identifies overdue action, the responsible party, and the event that reopens review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Warehouse Inventory Count when identity, count integrity, variance basis, approval, or verified posting remains unresolved. Retain the available Warehouse Inventory Count proof and route unresolved item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance scope to inventory control coordinator.
